scripts.dev: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && concurrently -k -s first "cross-env VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api npm --prefix ../frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron-forge start"
scripts.start: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-forge start
scripts.package: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-forge make
scripts.release:windows: npm run verify:security && npm run make && npm run verify:release
scripts.lint: node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/preload.cjs && node --check src/desktop-lifecycle.cjs && node --check src/ipc-security.cjs && node --check src/operation-control.cjs && node --check src/security-policy.cjs && node --check src/session-security.cjs && node --check src/status-document.cjs && node --check src/storage-recovery.cjs && node --check src/storage-transaction.cjs && node --check src/window-security.cjs && node --check scripts/build-backend.cjs && node --check scripts/check-dependency-inventory.cjs && node --check scripts/generate-icons.cjs && node --check scripts/run-node-tests.cjs && node --check scripts/smoke-packaged-backend.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-security.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-release.cjs && node --check forge.config.cjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:node
